definitions.gloss: Chinese person; Chinese national; a person from China
definitions.explanation: A person whose nationality is Chinese (the People's Republic of China), or who is ethnically Chinese. The term is used in the same neutral way as {日本人|にほんじん} or アメリカ{人|じん}.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}です。
{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}の{友達|ともだち}が{三人|さんにん}いる。
{観光地|かんこうち}には{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}の{旅行客|りょこうきゃく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many Chinese tourists at sightseeing spots.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{会社|かいしゃ}には{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}の{同僚|どうりょう}が{何人|なんにん}か{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: Several Chinese colleagues work at my company.

notes:
Composed of {中国|ちゅうごく} (China) and the suffix {〜人|じん} (person of a country), following the standard pattern for nationality nouns.

USAGE:
- Refers to Chinese nationals (citizens of the People's Republic of China) or to ethnic Chinese people. Context usually makes it clear which is meant.
- In casual spoken Japanese, people may also say {中国|ちゅうごく}の{人|ひと}, which is slightly softer and more conversational.
- The suffix {〜人|じん} is pronounced /jin/ after most country names (e.g., {日本人|にほんじん}, {韓国人|かんこくじん}, {中国人|ちゅうごくじん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中国人|ちゅうごくじん}の{観光客|かんこうきゃく}: Chinese tourists
- {中国人|ちゅうごくじん}{留学生|りゅうがくせい}: Chinese exchange student
- {在日|ざいにち}{中国人|ちゅうごくじん}: Chinese residents of Japan
- {中国人|ちゅうごくじん}の{友人|ゆうじん}: a Chinese friend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日本人|にほんじん}: Japanese person — same pattern with {日本|にほん}
- {韓国人|かんこくじん}: Korean person (South Korea) — same pattern with {韓国|かんこく}
- {台湾人|たいわんじん}: Taiwanese person — a person from Taiwan
- {華僑|かきょう}: overseas Chinese — ethnic Chinese living outside China, a more specialized term
